# Lexington Billiards & Spas

> Family-owned pool table, hot tub, and game room dealer in Lexington, KY since 1975.

## About
Lexington Billiards & Spas is Central Kentucky's oldest and most complete game room and outdoor living destination. Founded in 1975 by the Wilson family, we have been selling, delivering, installing, and servicing pool tables, hot tubs, Big Green Egg grills, and arcade machines for over 50 years. Our 5,000+ sq ft showroom is located at 1431 Leestown Rd, Lexington, KY 40511.

## Owner
Greg Wilson — second-generation owner and operator. 50+ years of combined family expertise in billiards, spas, and game room products.

## Products
- Pool Tables: C.L. Bailey, Brunswick, A.E. Schmidt, Connelly, Imperial, American Heritage
- Hot Tubs & Spas: American Whirlpool, Vita Spa (2-person to 8-person models, plus swim spas)
- Big Green Egg: All sizes from Mini to 2XL, EGGcessories, organic lump charcoal
- Arcade Machines: Custom multicade cabinets, bourbon barrel designs, virtual pinball, Raw Thrills commercial units
- Game Room Accessories: Falcon Cues, Toltec billiard lighting, RAM Game Room furniture, Imperial licensed sports gear (NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/NCAA)

## Services
- Free delivery within 50 miles of Lexington, KY
- Professional pool table installation, leveling, and assembly
- 29 Championship and Simonis cloth color options for pool tables
- Factory-authorized hot tub service and repair
- Pool table re-cloth and re-cushion
- Cue repair and maintenance
- Water chemistry and spa maintenance
- Financing available

## Service Area
Lexington, Georgetown, Frankfort, Nicholasville, Versailles, Winchester, Richmond, Paris, and all of Central Kentucky within a 50-mile radius.
